changes: Place of copying cleared: the colophon names only the scribe's vihāra, not where the copy was made; the vihāra stays as p1's affiliation/residence
p2 title 'mahāyātra' recorded as probably mahāpātra (य/प confusion); the doubtful 'श्रीव निज्य' discussed in notes
Date, scribe and owner roles, and wrote_for relation confirmed

persons.name: Rāmadatta
persons.evidence: लेखक- श्रीवंपि विहारि राम-दत्तेन परार्थहेतुना लिखितमिदं शास्त्रं

date.as_written: N. S. 500 (A.D. 1380) [Bendall's description; date portion of colophon not reproduced]

notes: Bendall left out the date clause and the scribe's verses, which are partly faded. The date NS 500 = A.D. 1380 comes from his physical description. 'श्रीवंपि विहारि' is the scribe's vihāra. The name is uncertain (Vaṃpi/Vampi-vihāra). It is not given as the place of copying. The owner's line is corrupt, and Bendall marked it (?) himself: 'श्रीव निज्य (?) महायात्र श्रीमजभाराकस्य (?) पुस्तकं'. 'महायात्र' is very probably mahāpātra. 'श्रीव निज्य' could hide vaṇij- ('merchant') or a place name. The personal name 'मजभाराक' is a very low-confidence reading: it might be 'śrīmaj-' + a name, or a garbled -bhāraka/bhāro title.
